Target, verify, compound

Zenith

Method · Sample research note

ON THIS PAGE
  1. Define the target
  2. Verify independently
  3. Promote and repeat
ABSTRACT

How a measurable objective becomes a repeatable loop for systems improvement.

01

Define the target

Write down the workload and the metric before proposing changes. Set the constraints that protect correctness, latency, and service behavior.

02

Verify independently

Run the candidate and baseline under comparable conditions. Repeat measurements where variance could change the conclusion, and retain the configuration and test inputs with the result.

03

Promote and repeat

Promote candidates that satisfy the constraints and improve the target. Keep a rollback path and use the newly verified baseline for the next experiment.
